samples.text: The clause "Use" is present in the left-hand version [1], but there is no corresponding clause in the right-hand version.

The clause specifies the permitted use of the premises. [1] This indicates that the Tenant is restricted to using the Premises for storage and distribution under Use Class B8. There is no corresponding clause in source 2.
evidence: The Tenant shall use the Premises only for storage and distribution within Use Class B8.

samples.text: The obligation of the Landlord to keep the structure and roof of the Premises in repair is made optional in the second version, as "shall" is replaced with "may" [2]. Additionally, the second version introduces a condition that the repair is to be done "at the Tenant's cost" [2], which is not present in the first version [1].
evidence: The Landlord may keep the structure and roof of the Premises in repair
The Landlord shall keep the structure and roof of the Premises in repair

samples.text: The restriction on the Tenant's ability to assign or underlet part of the Premises is removed. In source 1, the Tenant "shall not assign or underlet part only of the Premises," [1], while in source 2, the Tenant "may assign or underlet part only of the Premises," [2]. This change allows the Tenant to assign or underlet part of the Premises, which was previously prohibited.
evidence: The Tenant shall not assign or underlet part only of the Premises
The Tenant may assign or underlet part only of the Premises
